title: The Loose Protocol
author: Elodie Quintana
blurb: Gideon Vane, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
